summary: Tandoor Recipes: a self-hosted Django recipe manager exposing a DRF JSON API (OAuth2 + token auth) over a multi-tenant PostgreSQL store. Persists recipes, steps, ingredients, keywords, foods, units, properties, meal plans, shopping lists, inventory, storage-sync, AI providers/logs, invites, cook/view logs and more; each Space isolates data, users join via UserSpace membership with guest/user/admin groups.
